episodes: Cold open: sixteen hatches, one stuck. Luna's first act on the surface is selling the hatch's hinge.
School: Plack reads every classroom noticeboard aloud while Kuu hunts the lost-and-found box.
The peddler returns with Luna's own hinge for sale at double the price; a short, truly petty argument.
Midpoint swerve: the field recorder's last entry plays: the dead operator said the angels 'were counting us'.
Police and fire station: a locked evidence room, a cat, a fire truck that still starts.
Hospital: Plack stops speaking; there are no bodies and every bed has a name card in the same handwriting.
Low point: the stadium's stands are moving; the Crowd is assembling out of the angels that stood facing west.
Boss: the Crowd. Stinger: the recorder replay shows the rows of angels, all facing the sea. Luna says 'west it is' and pockets a playing card she did not mention.
Cold open: a city hangs from a chain into the fog; Kuu announces he is staying at the entrance.
Lifts and plank bridges; the residents ask for ID and are delighted when nobody has any.
Plack fixes the north lift; the residents elect Plack 'rota captain' by acclamation.
Midpoint swerve: every clock in the city shows 4:12. 'It has always been 4:12,' says a child, cheerfully.
A district of angels drifting down the chain; Kuu climbs links while narrating his own death.
Luna recruits her first unregistered operators and is told, kindly, that she is 'doing it wrong'.
Low point: the chain groans; the Anchorite is not defending the anchor, it is holding the city up.
Boss: the Anchorite. Stinger: the residents let the trio keep the lift schedule, and one clock moves to 4:13 for the first time in years.
Cold open: a friendly voice welcomes 'visitors' to A.R.C TECH. No one is here.
Intake hall: the voice rates each of the trio out of five. Luna asks it to rate Kuu twice.
Conveyors: cubes the colour of a sunrise; Plack picks one up and puts it back very carefully.
Midpoint swerve: the pallet stamp reads 1%. Plack says the number aloud and Kuu goes quiet.
Press hall: ten stampers, a timing run; Luna takes the safe route and then pretends she did not.
Robot-arm gauntlet; the voice narrates their death in advance, in the past tense, as a bedtime story.
Low point: the Foreman is a person-shaped automaton with a clipboard and it knows all three of their names.
Boss: the Foreman. Stinger: Luna's pocket is warm. She does not tell Plack or Kuu about the cube.
Cold open: a second arc, lit by a dim Moon, with a population sign that reads 0.
Gate plaza: flora in every doorway; Plack bows to a house.
Market: stalls fully stocked; Kuu counts the coins on every counter; none are missing.
Midpoint swerve: the beds are made, the plates are laid, the tombs on the cemetery wall are open and empty.
Lake: lily-pad stones; Luna argues with the Moon and the Moon wins by being large.
A house with three names carved in the door-frame: theirs, in an earlier hand.
Low point: the Gardener is not guarding anything; it is weeding.
Boss: the Gardener. Stinger: the Moon flickers the exact yellow of the cubes, for one second.
Cold open: a black shell taller than the ceiling; inside, a lobby with a plant and a bell.
Reception: Luna rings the bell nineteen times; Plack signs them in as visitors.
Cubicles: Kuu vaults desks; the coffee machine is warm.
Midpoint swerve: five doors that look exactly like walls. Behind them, folders. Two names repeat: ANGEL V1, OPERATOR V!.
Floor 6: a meeting room set for a meeting that already happened. The minutes are one line long.
Elevator shafts: Luna presses every button; the building notes this on a form.
Low point: the Auditor asks them to fill in a form, and if they refuse it fills it for them.
Boss: the Auditor. Stinger: the lobby clock chimes a time that is not the time and the plant has moved.
Cold open: rain pours through the grates; Luna looks at the demolition kit and puts it back in the bag.
The tunnel: angels in lanes, all moving the same way; Plack counts until the numbers are not useful.
A flood junction; Kuu volunteers to check the depth and goes under.
Midpoint swerve: every angel is carrying a shard. They are not attacking; they are delivering.
Pump room: a dive, a flooded control desk, a rubber duck Kuu insists on keeping.
Luna refuses to blow the tunnel: 'the explosives are damp.' Plack decides not to ask.
Low point: the lanes bend at the gate and the Toll Collector asks them for a ticket none of them have.
Boss: the Toll Collector. Stinger: Luna watches the last angel go by, shard glowing, toward the arc.
Cold open: a desert, a downpour, a wind that speaks three words and leaves.
Dunes: Kuu loses a boot and Plack finds a sock in a different place.
Cable trunks: climbing along the black lines of a thing buried in the sand.
Midpoint swerve: the data centre is lit, warm and tidy. It has been waiting.
Cooling towers; steam; the vents breathe a low note Kuu says he can feel in his teeth.
Server hall: the small screen, the damaged Morse; Luna says she can read it. She cannot.
Low point: the Uptime assembles from server racks and the hall's lights say, over and over, 'Operator failed.'
Boss: the Uptime. Stinger: the hum does not stop when they leave. It follows them across the desert.
Cold open: a pastel island, a chair as tall as a house; nothing here is real, which does not help.
Luna's island: a waiting room where the television is off, and she waits anyway.
Kuu's island: a street he cannot leave; every shop sells one thing: apologies.
Midpoint swerve: the Morse in the floor reads 'THE ANGELS BRING MERCY FOR ALL'. Under it, a smaller line: 'not those'.
Plack's island: a wedding cake that bleeds and a guest list written in teeth.
Impossible stairs; hyper-real horrors walking past; Luna decides to ignore them out of rudeness.
Low point: the Mimic wears Luna's face and says what she is afraid to: 'I do not know why I am doing this.'
Boss: the Mimic. Stinger: the fourth Morse line, 'THE REST ARE ALL FILTH COMPARED TO ITS EXISTENCE', is carved by someone who had time.
Cold open: sunshine, rain, a brass band; the trio are 'guests of honour' of a city that has never been touched.
Tour: Luna eats five meals; Plack reads the menu and finds the same wing logo on every plate.
Midpoint swerve: Plack proposes. The city streams it live to the whole arc; the sponsors name the moment.
Wedding, 2009: Luna and Plack are married on a rooftop garden under waterfalls; Kuu is best-person and loses the rings twice.
The service tunnels: the rationing office, the queue, the same logo.
Luna collects receipts instead of souvenirs; Kuu finds the people who cook the food and cannot eat it.
Low point: the Ambassador crashes the reception to 'bless the union', on camera, for the sponsor.
Boss: the Ambassador in the lagoon. Stinger: Luna takes the cheque, tears it in half, and says, quietly, 'I'm done being nice.'
Cold open: dawn over the spire; Luna rehearses the speech to a mirror and rejects three drafts.
Lobby: the trio walk in on a school tour and are given visitor stickers.
Studio floors: a quiz show set; Kuu wins a toaster while avoiding a guard.
Midpoint swerve: the transmitter is guarded by the Primetime Squad, who recognise them from the Paradise wedding.
Climb: the antenna mast; Plack fixes the wiring while Luna reads her speech out loud.
Luna goes live. Plack reads over her shoulder and changes one word. The feed is cut in the middle of 'oppression'.
Low point: Kuu is shot while holding the door; he says it is a flesh wound and passes out.
Boss: Primetime Squad. Stinger: the commanders' answer comes in on every screen: 'Luna is a war criminal.' She says, 'Good title.'
Cold open: Media at a mixing desk at 4 a.m., eating cereal, listening to the arc's secrets.
The studio: a defunct subway station with a hundred wires and a single chair.
Jammer drones; Media's patch panel puzzle, solved with music.
Midpoint swerve: the speech's metadata contained a kill order that triggered on a single word.
Signal tunnels: Media reconnects the relay and rereads her old broadcast, the damaged Morse from the desert.
Plack arrives with soup and no questions; Media does not take it and then does.
Low point: the Jammer Choir takes the studio; Media's tapes are burning.
Boss: Jammer Choir. Stinger: dawn; Luna arrives with a coffee she did not pay for and says she owes Media nothing, and will pay it all back.
Cold open: a hand-painted sign in the Underworld: 'LUNA PAYS ON TIME.'
The sign-in table: Plack's clipboard, Kuu's patience, Luna's briefing about 'chess pieces'.
Hanging City operators arrive and ask where the lift is.
Midpoint swerve: the contract: sponsor owns your likeness, voice, and a third of your wages.
Recruit missions: four operators, four terrible reasons, one of them about soup.
A recruit smiles too much. Kuu watches him. Luna does not.
Low point: the Underworld is ambushed; the recruit sold the table.
Boss: Repo. Stinger: Plack asks what the recruit was being paid. Luna writes the question down.

cuts: The ruling: commanders are subject to law
episodes: Cold open: Judge at dawn, in a courthouse that smells of floor wax, reading statutes to nobody.
First case: an operator accused of 'organising without a sponsor'.
Bailiff automata; a witness who is a vending machine.
Midpoint swerve: the charge sheet is typed in a house style Judge has seen before and cannot place.
Cell block: Judge refuses to let the accused be moved; the bailiffs disagree.
In chambers: the precedent of the first law after 2002, in her own hand.
Low point: the Bailiff Prime arrives with an order to remove her from the bench.
Boss: the Bailiff Prime. Stinger: the ruling: commanders are subject to the same law. Luna reads it that night, twice.
Cold open: Kuu's ledger shows nine coins missing; he is sure it is ten.
The Exchange: stall-holders who all smile the same smile.
A ledger vault; a spy-hunt that Luna treats like a game.
Midpoint swerve: the spy is a recruit with a sick sibling and a medical contract.
Luna pays him. 'A business deal.' Plack looks at her for a long time.
The Broker's men arrive; the floor becomes a fight.
Low point: Luna realises she does not know how much a favour is worth.
Boss: the Broker. Stinger: a stall-holder tells her a favour is worth exactly one person. She does not like that.
Cold open: the Deck at night; Gambler dealing herself a hand she will not play.
The floor: odds on Luna written on a board above the bar; they are not good.
A backer is buying every bet against Luna with money that has no fund.
Midpoint swerve: the vault; the chips have a wing stamp.
A chip-count puzzle; Gambler does the sum in her head and says nothing.
A visitor with a playing card asks for the house's blessing.
Low point: the backer's dealer flips the table and the casino is on fire.
Boss: the Backer's Dealer. Stinger: Gambler recognises Luna's card: 'That's not mine.' The only house in the arc that leaves cards is the Jester's.
Cold open: every clock in the district points to the same minute.
Cathedral nave; Plack leads because the Timekeeper finds Plack interesting.
Gear halls: rooms that freeze when you stop moving.
Midpoint swerve: Kuu notices that the stopped places are where the government has no records.
The Timekeeper explains: 'time you are not counted in cannot be taxed.'
A hall with clocks that are stopped for no reason at all. The Timekeeper will not look at it.
Low point: the Minute Hand sweeps the nave; the trio must keep moving or be paused.
Boss: the Minute Hand. Stinger: 'I never stopped that one,' the Timekeeper says. 'Someone else did.'
Cold open: a greenhouse and a smell of burnt sugar; Alchemist adding a drop to a cube.
Blood hauls crates and complains about the weight of the glassware.
Test one: the subject sits up, blinks, and asks for tea.
Midpoint swerve: test two; the subject does not ask for tea.
Laboratory fights; chemical hazards; Blood keeps Alchemist alive and tells her about it.
The ceiling: the 1% is a limit, not a choice; past it, they become something else.
Low point: Overdose breaks the glass walls.
Boss: Overdose. Stinger: Alchemist writes 1 on a label and puts the project in a drawer.
Cold open: a library with no roof and a floor of pages.
Reading rooms that rearrange when read.
The drafts of Luna's charge, with margin notes.
Midpoint swerve: the loudspeaker voice from A.R.C TECH is the Narrator's, recorded years ago.
The central reading room; the Narrator receives them, politely, in the third person.
The offer: a better ending for her silence. Luna asks for a worse one with more jokes.
Low point: the Editor attacks; the walls fold; Plack loses a page she needed.
Boss: the Editor. Stinger: a page on the desk with Luna's name and no ending.
Cold open: the observatory; Weather swears at a barometer; Stargazer draws a star that is not there.
Instrument galleries; wind gusts; a map pinned to every wall.
The storm front: not weather; it moves too evenly.
Midpoint swerve: every angel's path in the last year, drawn as a line; they meet at a single point.
The hole in the map: a place where nothing converges.
Weather names the first point 'the Centre' and will not name the second.
Low point: the Stormfront takes the observatory floor by floor.
Boss: the Stormfront. Stinger: Stargazer circles the hole in red and writes 'do not'.
Cold open: a carousel under Neo Tokyo plays a tune Luna half remembers.
Midway: shooting gallery with real targets.
Game one: the mirror house; Luna wins by seeing which mirror is bored.
Midpoint swerve: game three is rigged against her and the Jester says so, out loud, to the whole tent.
Luna cheats. The Jester applauds. Kuu is made the target.
Plack does not speak to Luna for the rest of the night.
Low point: the Ringmaster Machine tries to eject them.
Boss: the Ringmaster Machine. Stinger: the Jester's vote is hers, and something between her and Kuu is spent.
Cold open: the Cadet Cup; Adapt in a whistle and a sun visor.
Training halls: courses that change to suit the cadet who is running them.
Live-fire course: the targets are learning.
Midpoint swerve: a sponsor's representative changes the ammunition mid-run.
The course adapts exactly as designed and the cadets are in it.
Adapt tears up its own rules in the control tower.
Low point: the Sponsor's Warden sweeps the range.
Boss: the Sponsor's Warden. Stinger: Adapt will join Luna on one condition: that the course adapts to her.
Cold open: the Mortuary Level; tiers of names; the trio talk too much to cover the quiet.
The upper tier: Plack reads the wall aloud, name by name.
Crypt lanterns: relight in order to find the stair.
Midpoint swerve: a ledger open on a lectern with their own names in it and a single word: visited.
Death receives them; the true casualty count since 2002.
Luna tries a joke and the hall does not answer.
Low point: Death asks whether a count is a life.
Boss: the Pallbearers. Stinger: Death will attend the unification. It asked for one thing: an answer.
Cold open: a Barracks canteen; three trays; three three-stars; one broken kettle.
The shift: branded armour that does not fit; a manager who calls them 'talent'.
Ishii counts the hours. Shiraishi writes the grievances. Arita tapes the armour.
Midpoint swerve: a month's wages are in the sponsor's vault.
The heist: small, loud, over-prepared; one lift and a mop bucket.
A table is placed in the canteen with a sign: COUNCIL, in marker.
Low point: the Compliance Officer arrives with a clipboard.
Boss: the Compliance Officer. Stinger: Luna's recruiters find the table and understand it is the thing she has been looking for.
Cold open: the elevator of the government tower; the music is a sponsored jingle.
Lobby: truce rules read aloud by a guard who is plainly afraid.
Floors: offices; a thousand framed logos; Kuu is offered a sponsorship by an intern.
Midpoint swerve: seven commanders under a ceiling of wings.
The Table: hardliners and reformers split in front of her, on purpose.
Plack names the logo on the ceiling: the Paradise wing.
Low point: the truce ends at the chamber door.
Boss: the Sovereign Guard. Stinger: Luna leaves with the reformers' names and a coffee she does not drink.
Cold open: two three-stars in dress uniforms at a gala, holding canapes they cannot afford.
Backstage: the rig is not for the show; the cages are warm.
The cage vault: lock puzzles under a stage.
Midpoint swerve: the angels in the cages are the same angels from the Intersection, with shards.
Fujita breaks locks quietly; Myrcia talks the guards to sleep.
The stage lights up and the audience applauds a rescue that does not happen.
Low point: the Showrunner catches them and offers them a contract.
Boss: the Showrunner. Stinger: a cage label with a number and the name of a factory.
Cold open: the lights are on again at A.R.C TECH; there are people this time.
Intake: engineers in the same uniform, polite and tired.
Line halls: cubes the size of fists; the voice says 'welcome back'.
Midpoint swerve: the cradle hall. One empty cradle: ANGEL V1, RELEASED TO CUSTODY.
Kuu finds the custody log. The Patron is a Secret.
Plack reads the signature. It is the same wing.
Low point: Foreman Mk II knows what they have read.
Boss: Foreman Mk II. Stinger: Luna wrecks the Line anyway. 'It will make another.' 'Then it will have to find another Luna.'
Cold open: Terminus Nine; a train with three reformer commanders and a fourth on the roof.
Platform: reformers bicker over seats.
Station one: sabotage; a signal that will not change.
Midpoint swerve: Plack leaves at station two; Luna says 'ends justify means' and means it.
Kuu stays. It costs him something.
The hardliners' armoured train catches up.
Low point: the coupling between Luna's carriage and the reformers' carriage fails.
Boss: the Hardliner Train. Stinger: Plack returns without a word and with a sandwich.
Cold open: a vault under the old city hall; three doors, three labels: Operators, Secrets, Government.
Archive halls: the Charter's first clause is a blank page.
Operators' room: a barracks that asks the player questions.
Midpoint swerve: Secrets' room: a stage where someone is already rehearsing.
Government's room: a court that rules against Luna and she thanks it.
The Charter is drafted by the three of them on the floor.
Low point: the Guardian tests the text; the seventh line stays blank.
Boss: the Charter Guardian. Stinger: 'It is the only line that matters.' Luna asks Judge to find the one who belongs there.
Cold open: Judge at the lift to the sanctum, adjusting her gavel.
Corridors: a white that gets whiter; the Hush walk behind.
Honour-guard hall: silence mechanics; Judge declines to use her voice.
Midpoint swerve: Angel is not a prisoner; he stands as a host.
Angel and Judge talk for a day; he is courteous in every sentence and contemptuous in every pause.
He will sign, 'like a verdict: in advance and without surprise.'
Low point: the Hush test Judge; she is weighed and does not know it.
Boss: the Hush. Stinger: his mark is a small black circle of red glyphs.

cuts: Luna and Kuu on the roof
episodes: Cold open: the Operators' dome the night before; a banner, a cake, a speech that will never be given.
Corridor parties; arguments in kitchens; the Jester sets up a dunk tank.
Luna and Kuu on a roof: they talk about the third game and do not settle it.
Midpoint swerve: the Narrator's forged Charter, a thousand copies, printing.
Printing hall; Plack changes a page by hand.
Luna and Plack on the roof, not talking, and then talking.
Low point: the Final Edition is a press the size of a house.
Boss: the Final Edition. Stinger: 'Write whatever you like, under my name.' The Narrator, after a long silence, says yes.
Cold open: Death at a desk, sorting.
Year room 2002: the counted rise and do not speak.
Year room 2003-2005: Death walks through, annotating.
Midpoint swerve: a new column in the ledger, in red glyphs: unworthy.
Year room 2008: a name that was never written down.
Death refuses the column and the column writes itself.
Low point: the Unsigned wakes.
Boss: the Unsigned. Stinger: Death will sign in the morning, and the pen will hover.
Cold open: dawn in the Great Hall; the signatories file in.
Opening address; Luna deletes half of it.
Midpoint swerve: Commander Prime's coup fires as the first pen touches paper.
Hold the hall: waves while signatures are collected.
The war mech breaches the doors.
Low point: Plack takes a hit meant for Luna and keeps walking.
The last signature. One minute when everyone is on one side.
Stinger: Death and Angel put their pens down, stand, and declare humanity, Operators and every other Secret unworthy of life.
Cold open: the hall empties in seconds; Death and Angel walk out untouched.
The Council demands the Secrets disarm.
The Secrets demand the government dissolve.
Midpoint swerve: the Operators' dome burns; no one will say who lit it.
Plack is hurt shielding a civilian; Kuu carries them out.
Luna runs between three districts with the last copy of the Charter.
Low point: the Colossus walks.
Boss: the Hardliner Colossus. Stinger: on the surface the angels are in rows, facing the arc.

cuts: The truce on the lighthouse stair
episodes: Cold open: three flags on three fronts; three speeches; one rain.
Docks front: the lighthouse beam sweeps a sea that is empty.
Operators' Warlord: a champion who is not a villain.
Midpoint swerve: the Moon flickers cube-yellow a second time.
Hanging City: the chain is cut at one link; the city shifts.
Luna defeats each champion and refuses to kill them.
Low point: all three champions wake to a surface full of angels.
Boss: the Warlord of the Docks. Stinger: truce signed on the lighthouse stair; it will last two days.
Cold open: the map in Stargazer's drawer has a hole in it; Luna walks into it.
Entry: grey; white noise; no one speaks.
Echo of Neo Tokyo: a crossing with a figure at every corner.
Midpoint swerve: the counted stand in rows and do not look at them.
Echo of the Docks; echo of the Hanging City; each holds something they left behind.
The data-centre echo: the small screen now says their names.
Low point: Death meets them at the exit and asks again.
Boss: Death. Stinger: Luna answers. The counted lie down.
Cold open: dawn at the village; the rain stops.
The torii, the shrine stair, a villager who knows their names.
The paddies: the angel host in a wave.
Midpoint swerve: the monolith's voice speaks through Angel, who is waiting at its foot.
The river: the bridge breaks; they hold it.
The monolith: glyphs go out one by one as Luna uses the black and white hole.
Low point: Angel is certain; Luna is not; she does it anyway.
Boss: Angel. Stinger/epilogue: spring 2017; Judge's courtroom; Luna asks to be tried; Plack at her side, Kuu at the door; it is raining in Neo Tokyo.
